Day names verified against kingshotguide.org's KvK calculator — D1 City Construction, D2 Basic Skills Up, D3 Pet Training, D4 Hero Development, D5 Power Boost.

Where the alliance tip is more conservative than the raw calculator (TrueGold D2/D5, Charms D1/D3, Mithril/Forgehammer/Widget D4), it's likely because a better window exists later — not because the calculator is wrong.
This is the main event. Hold Mithril, Widgets, and Forgehammers through all of KvK if Officer Project T1 is closer — it out-scores even KvK D5 for those three items.
